source: 625 Repentance
target: 625 Paenitentia

source: Ice‑blue eyes!
target: Oculi, ut glacies, caerulei!

source: That Demon!
target: Ille daemon!

source: It’s lurking right there in the cathedral!
target: Ibi in cathedralo insidiatur!

source: Lumian tensed.
target: Lumian se contraxit.

source: Without a second thought, he tried to teleport away.
target: Nullo secundo cogitatione, conatus est se translocare.

source: This time, he chose Trier–the entrance to Saint Viève Cathedral!
target: Hoc tempore, Trier elegit – ostium Cathedralis Sanctae Viève!

source: In that moment, his reflection stared back at him in those chilling, ice‑blue eyes.
target: Illo momento, imago eius eum aspexit in his terribilibus, glacie caeruleis oculis!

source: His face twisted, expression sinister, eyes cold.
target: Facies eius contorta, vultus malignus, et oculi frigidi!

source: Soon, Lumians manifested, encircling him.
target: Mox, Lumiani apparuerunt, eum circumdantes.

source: There was one Lumian, eyes intoxicated, breathing heavy, face flushed red.
target: Erat unus Lumian, cui oculi inebriati erant, graviter respirans, et facies rubicunda!

source: Another, trembling in fear.
target: Alter, metu tremens.

source: Another, expressionless and resolute.
target: Alter, impassibilis et constans.

source: One, lost and sorrowful.
target: Unus, perditus et tristis.

source: Another, with no will to live.
target: Alter, sine voluntate vivendi.

source: And one more, eyes filled with anger and hatred, red with intensity…
target: Et adhuc alter, oculis irae et odii plenis, rubris cum vehementia!

source: In an instant, Lumian seemed to multiply into countless versions, each appearing tangible.
target: In momento, Lumian videbatur multiplicari in innumerabiles species, quarum unaquaeque apparens erat palpabilis.

source: This severely impacted his thoughts and actions, hindering him from activating the contract mark representing Spirit World Traversal.
target: Hoc graviter cogitationes eius et actus mutavit, impediendo eum activare sigillum contractum, quod Transitus Mundi Spiritus repraesentat.

source: Instinctively, he focused his remaining will on his right hand and the mark left by Blood Emperor Alista Tudor.
target: Instinctu, reliquam voluntatem suam in manum dextram atque in sigillum ab Imperatore Sanguinis Alista Tudor relictum intendit.

source: To escape this state and gain the strength to teleport away, he needed to terrify the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon!
target: Ut ex hoc statu evaderet et vires ad se translocandum acquireret, necesse erat daemonem oculis glacie caeruleis terrere!

source: Suddenly, Lumian heard ravings filled with intense madness and depravity.
target: Subito, Lumian audivit deliramenta intensae insaniae atque depravationis plena.

source: His mind turned to mush, swelling dangerously.
target: Mens eius in pastam se convertebat, periculosissime inflata.

source: The Blood Emperor’s aura didn’t activate in time.
target: Aura Imperatoris Sanguinis non in tempore activata est.

source: Fragmented, emotional, and painful thoughts burst in Lumian’s mind like fireworks before gradually descending.
target: Fragmentatae, affectuosae, et dolorosae cogitationes in mente Lumiani quasi pyrotechnicae eruperunt, deinde paulatim descendentes.

source: An intense burning sensation in his chest anchored him, preventing complete loss of self.
target: Intensus sensus ardoris in pectore eius eum tenuit, impediens ne totam sui existentiam amitteret.

source: After an unknown span of time, Lumian finally regained command of his thoughts.
target: Post tempus ignotum, Lumian tandem dominium cogitationum suarum recuperavit.

source: His first thought was: I’m still alive?
target: Prima cogitatio eius fuit: "Vivo adhuc?"

source: It must have been a considerable duration since the onslaught of ravings and his subsequent awakening.
target: Fieri debet ut longum tempus ab impetu deliramentorum et ejus posteriore expergiscentia transierit.

source: The Demon’s power could have easily ended him multiple times!
target: Potentia daemonis eum facile multoties interficere potuit!

source: As Lumian concentrated on his right hand, he scrutinized the Demon with ice‑blue eyes.
target: Dum Lumian in manum dextram intendit, daemonem oculis glacie caeruleis perscrutabatur.

source: The white‑haired Demon, adorned in a black formal suit and bow tie, sat upright once more, facing the Sacred Emblem of Life.
target: Daemon albis capillis, indutus veste formali nigra et papiliono ligato, iterum erectus sedebat, ad Sacrum Emblema Vitae spectans.

source: It inclined slightly, crossing its arms over its chest.
target: Levis inclinavit, brachia in pectore transversa coniungens.

source: Shutting its eyes, it whispered with a pained expression, “Oh, merciful Mother, I implore your mercy for my transgressions…”
target: Claudens oculos, vultu dolenti, susurravit: "O mater misericors, te obsecro, miserationem tuam pro peccatis meis…"

source: Merciful Mother, I implore your mercy for my transgressions…
target: O mater misericors, te obsecro, miserationem tuam pro peccatis meis…

source: Lumian’s resolve wavered as he abandoned activating the Blood Emperor’s aura.
target: Resolutio Lumiani vacillavit, cum auram Imperatoris Sanguinis activare deseruit.

source: He settled beside the Demon.
target: Se iuxta Daemonem collocavit.

source: Observing the Sacred Emblem of Life on the altar, he waited silently, refraining from disrupting the Demon’s repentance.
target: Contemplans Sacrum Emblema Vitae in altare, silentiose exspectavit, abstinens a turbando paenitentiam Daemonis.

source: Contemplating his encounter, he mused quietly.
target: Cogitans de congressu suo, tacite meditatus est.

source: The various selves I witnessed must be genuine illusions–not existing in the physical world but within my heart and mind…
target: Varii mei, quos perspexi, verae illusiones esse debent – non in mundo physico, sed in corde atque mente mea…

source: Could this be a sophisticated manifestation of emotional and desire fluctuations, triggering individual emotions and desires to vie for control of the body without reaching the point of dissociation?
target: Num hoc sit subtilis manifestatio fluctuum affectuum et cupiditatum, quae singulos affectus ac desideria ad certamen de potestate corporis excitat, ne ad punctum dissociationis perveniant?

source: The subsequent ravings resembled Naboredisley’s frenzied curse upon expulsion.
target: Deliramenta subsequentes similes erant execrationi freneticae Naboredisley ad expulsionem.

source: Yet, this time, there was no shield from Mr. Fool’s gray fog. Well, not entirely absent. Otherwise, the mad river of ravings would have capsized my identity.
target: Attamen, hoc tempore, nullum scutum ex nebula grisea Domini Stulti erat. Saltem non omnino absens; alioquin, flumen insanum deliramentorum identitatem meam submersisset.

source: Even if I hadn’t lost control, I would have succumbed completely before the Demon found its “conscience” and started repenting…
target: Etiamsi imperium meum non perderem, penitus cederem antequam daemonem suam "conscientiam" inveniret et paenitentiam inciperet…

source: I believed the safest haven on Hanth Island was the cathedral of the Church of Earth Mother.
target: Credidi tutissimum refugium in Insula Hanth esse, scilicet cathedralem Ecclesiae Terrae Matris.

source: I specifically chose it to evade the Demon.
target: Illud speciatim elegi ad daemonem effugiendum.

source: Surprisingly, it’s praying here…
target: Mirum, hic orat…

source: Judging by this, blind trust in the orthodox Church’s cathedrals might not be foolproof in the future.
target: His rebus consideratis, fides caeca in cathedralibus Ecclesiae orthodoxae fortasse in futuro non omnino certissima erit.

source: Without adequate information, nothing is absolute…
target: Sine informatione idonea, nihil absolutum est…

source: Yet, it was only within the cathedral that I survived.
target: Tamen solum in cathedralo supervixi.

source: Anywhere else, it would be Termiboros grappling with the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon.
target: Alibi, Termiboros cum daemone oculis glacie caeruleis certare deberet.

source: Then, the Angels of the orthodox Churches and the Tarot Club would descend…
target: Deinde, Angeli Ecclesiarum orthodoxarum atque Tarot Club descendere coeperent…

source: Lumian had formed some hypotheses and waited with assurance.
target: Lumian aliquas hypothesēs finxit et cum fiducia exspectavit.

source: He condensed his experiences and absorbed his lesson.
target: Experientias suas condensavit et doctrinam suam absorpsit.

source: After a brief span, the white‑haired, ice‑blue‑eyed Demon, donned in a black formal suit, concluded its repentance.
target: Post breve tempus, daemon albis capillis et oculis glacie caeruleis, indutus veste formali nigra, paenitentiam suam conclusit.

source: Its expression regained composure, but the blood vessels in its eyes deepened.
target: Vultus eius compositum restituit, sed vasa sanguinea in oculis eius profundiora facta sunt.

source: Only then did Lumian observe the black leather gloves on both of its hands.
target: Tum tantum Lumian observavit chirothecas ex corio nigro in utraque manu eius.

source: Even during confession and prayer, they remained unremoved–a departure from devout believer behavior.
target: Etiam in confessione et oratione, illae non removebantur – ab more devotorum fideli differebant.

source: In the human world, wearing gloves while praying was deemed disrespectful to a deity, except in emergencies or special circumstances.
target: In mundo humano, gerere chirothecas dum orationem faciebat putabatur irreverens erga deum, nisi in casibus urgentibus aut specialibus condicionibus.

source: The same applied to wearing a hat.
target: Idem valet ad gerendum pileum.

source: The Demon cast a glance at Lumian and spoke in a deep but composed voice, “You haven’t fled yet. Aren’t you afraid of angering me again?”
target: Daemon, intuens Lumianum et voce profunda sed composita, dixit: "Nondum fugisti. Nonne times me iterum irascere?"

source: Lumian gazed at the Sacred Emblem of Life and smiled.
target: Lumian ad Sacrum Emblema Vitae aspexit et subridens fuit.

source: “I’m not. This is Earth Mother’s cathedral.”
target: "Non; haec est ecclesia cathedralis Terrae Matris."

source: “Weren’t we in the cathedral just now?” The Demon moderated its volume, not disturbing the other supplicants.
target: "Num nuper in cathedralo fuimus?" inquit daemon, modum vocis moderans, ne ceteros supplicantes inquietaret.

source: “Occasional accidents are understandable,” Lumian replied unhurriedly.
target: "Casus fortuiti intellegibiles sunt," respondit Lumian leniter.

source: “Moreover, I believe you can certainly control yourself in a short period. It’ll be more challenging beyond half a year.”
target: "Praeterea, credo te certe te ipsum in brevi tempore regere posse. Ultra dimidium anni difficilius erit."

source: The Demon also directed its gaze at the altar, its ice‑blue eyes reflecting the Sacred Emblem of Life.
target: Daemon etiam altari intuens, oculis glacie caeruleis Sacrum Emblema Vitae reflectentibus, dixit:

source: “Why do you think so?”
target: "Cur ita putas?"

source: “I’m an experienced adventurer,” Lumian said with a smile.
target: "Experientiam habeo in adventuris," inquit Lumian subridens.

source: I know that orthodox Churches adhere to a common rule.
target: Scio Ecclesias orthodoxas regulam communem observare.

source: Survivors entangled in a mysticism incident are often drawn into the Church if there’s any hidden danger.
target: Qui superstiterunt et in incidentibus mysticis implicati sunt, saepe in Ecclesiam inducuntur, si periculum latens adsit.

source: They become civilian staff and receive long‑term protection to prevent sudden deaths.
target: Fiunt ministerii civiles et longam tutelam acquirunt ad mortem repentem impediendam.

source: However, those who witnessed the Demon’s figure on Hanth Island didn’t undergo this process.
target: Attamen, qui figuram Daemoni in Insula Hanth conspexerunt, hunc processum non susceperunt.

source: They only received a few months of protection before departing.
target: Solum paucos menses tutelam acceperunt antequam discesserunt.

source: Could it be that the Church fears prolonged stays might lead to deaths even within the cathedral or cloister?
target: Num Ecclesia timeat diuturnas mansiones, quae etiam in cathedralo aut claustro ad mortes ducere possint?

source: In such instances, it would undoubtedly tarnish the Church’s reputation. One can’t keep a constant watch on higher‑level powers indefinitely.
target: In his casibus, indubitanter famam Ecclesiae macularet; neque quisquam potest potentias superiores indefinito tempore vigilare.

source: The white‑haired Demon fell silent for a few moments before confessing, “I didn’t want to kill them, but I…”
target: Daemon albis capillis paucis momentis silentium tenuit, antequam confiteretur: "Non volui eos interficere, sed ego…"

source: At this point, its face twisted once more, icy‑blue eyes filled with pain.
target: In hoc puncto, facies eius iterum contorta est, et oculi glacie caerulei dolore pleni erant.

source: Once again, it crossed its arms over its chest, resuming a low‑voiced prayer.
target: Iterum brachia in pectore transversa coniunxit, et precationem voce humilis repetit.

source: This time, it swiftly regained its composure.
target: Hoc tempore, celeriter compositum suum restituit.

source: Lumian resumed the conversation with a smile.
target: Lumian colloquium subridens repetivit.

source: “Don’t tell me you penned all those epitaphs for those people?”
target: "Noli mihi dicere te omnes illas epitaphas pro illis hominibus scripsisse?"

source: “That’s correct.” The Demon in the black suit maintained its slightly forward‑leaning posture.
target: "Ita est." Dixit daemon in veste formali nigra, qui leviter inclinata staturam retinuit.

source: It seems this Demon has a rather amicable relationship with the Church of Earth Mother… Not strictly devout, but a believer nonetheless…
target: Videtur hic daemon relationem amicam cum Ecclesia Terrae Matris habere… Non tam strictim devotum, sed tamen fautorem esse…

source: Lumian understood that the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon wouldn’t respond even if he inquired.
target: Lumian intellexit daemonem oculis glacie caeruleis non respondebit, etiam si rogasset.

source: Such questions might even provoke serious consequences.
target: Talia quaestiones etiam graves consequentias excitare possent.

source: He had to capitalize on its stable emotions to seek some details.
target: Debuit inniti stabilibus eius affectibus ut quaedam indicia perquireret.

source: Before Lumian could speak, the Demon posed a question.
target: Priusquam Lumian loqui posset, daemon quaestionem proposuit.

source: “Foreigner, why did you come to Hanth Island?”
target: "Extraneus, cur ad Insulam Hanth venisti?"

source: Lumian deliberately smiled.
target: Lumian deliberatē subridens fuit.

source: “I previously encountered a Demon incident…”
target: "Prius casum Daemonis expertus sum…"

source: Lumian briefly recounted Salah’s encounter with the Love Incantation in Port Colla.
target: Lumian breviter narravit de occurrentia Salaha cum Incantatione Amoris in Portu Colla.

source: While leading the investigation, the suspect’s body had been suddenly commandeered by a Demon seeking a deal, which he rejected.
target: Dum inquisitionem duceret, corpus suspecti subito a Daemone, qui pactum petebat, occupatum est, quod ille reiecit.

source: Lumian, utilizing undisclosed official powers, had then expelled the other party.
target: Lumian, officiis occultis utens, deinde adversarium expulit.

source: Lumian omitted details about the Love Incantation’s content and refrained from mentioning Naboredisley’s name, fearing deep‑seated animosity that might trigger intense agitation.
target: Lumian singularia de contento Incantationis Amoris omisit et nomen Naboredisley non commemoravit, metuens inimicitias profundi radicati, quae agitationem intenser excitare possent.

source: Concluding, he stated, “I read in the notebook about Demon legends on Hanth Island, connected to the deal the Demon sought. Intrigued, I decided to investigate. My intention wasn’t to finish off anyone.”
I read in the notebook about Demon legends on Hanth Island, connected to the deal the Demon sought.
target: In schedulo legi de legendis Daemonum in Insula Hanth, quae ad pactum, quod Daemon petebat, pertinuerunt.

source: Intrigued, I decided to investigate.
target: Curiosus factus, decrevi inquiri.

source: My intention wasn’t to finish off anyone.
target: Intentio mea non erat quemquam interficere.

source: “You can’t finish off anyone either,” the Demon with ice‑blue eyes remarked candidly.
target: "Neque quemquam interficere potes," daemon oculis glacie caeruleis aperte dixit.

source: It continued gazing at the Sacred Emblem of Life and added in a calm, deep voice, “Curiosity kills the cat.”
target: Continuavit ad Sacrum Emblema Vitae aspexitque et voce tranquila et profunda addidit: "Curiositas felem occidit."

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian leviter subridens fuit.

source: “It’s indeed risky, but finding you within a day and discovering the sealed valley indicates my capabilities.”
target: "Revera periculosum est, sed te intra unum diem invenire et vallem sigillatam reperire facultates meas ostendit."

source: Next time, I’ll choose a safer “sanctuary.”
target: Proximo tempore, tutiorem sanctuarium eligebo.

source: The Demon with ice‑blue eyes, with few wrinkles, smiled—an uncommon sight.
target: Daemon oculis glacie caeruleis, paucis rugis, subridens est—visio rara!

source: “Your methods are unconventional, but they align with the mysticism world’s underlying laws.
target: "Methodi tuae non sunt consuetae, sed legibus fundamentis orbis mystici congruunt.

source: “But had I not controlled myself and repented for past deeds, you would be dead. Such an investigation would have been futile.”
target: "Sed nisi me temperavero et pro factis praeteritis paenitentiam egimussem, mortuus esses; talis investigatio fuisset vana."

source: Lumian didn’t dispute.
target: Lumian non disputavit.

source: With the information he gathered, he knew there was no immediate danger in the cathedral of the Church of Earth Mother.
target: Ex informationibus collectis, sciebat in cathedral Ecclesiae Terrae Matris nullum periculum imminens esse.

source: The recent episode proved to be a false alarm.
target: Recens eventus falsum alarmum fuit.

source: He shifted the topic.
target: Argumentum mutavit.

source: “Why did that inexplicable Demon target you?
target: "Cur ille daemon inexplicabilis te oppugnare constituit?"

source: “Moreover, with the strength of me and my companions, it’s likely impossible to eradicate a so‑called Demon descendant like you. Was it deliberately leading us to our demise?”
target: "Praeterea, cum vi mea et comitibus meis, verisimile est ut exterminare daemonis generis descendentem ut te non possimus. Num id conscie nos ad interitum deduxit?"

source: The Demon, clad in a black suit, kept its gaze fixed on the Sacred Emblem of Life and responded, “I’m not certain which one you encountered.”
target: Daemon, indutus veste formali nigra, oculos in Sacrum Emblema Vitae ficiens, respondit: "Non certus sum, cuius daemonii congressum habuisti."

source: It refused to disclose more.
target: Negavit plura patefacere.

source: Lumian didn’t dare press further, let alone provoke.
target: Lumian ultra insistere non ausus est, nedum provocare.

source: His mind raced, searching for an alternate approach.
target: Mens eius festinanter cursit, alteram viam quaerens.

source: “You seem unrestricted. Why not leave Hanth Island?
target: "Videtur te esse sine vinculis. Cur Insulam Hanth non relinquis?"

source: “There appears to be some force influencing you here.”
target: "Videtur aliqua vis te hic afficere."

source: The Demon’s expression twisted as it stated, “This is my duty and my atonement.
target: Vultus daemonis contortus est, dum diceret: "Hoc est officium meum et expiatio mea."

source: “Since converting to Earth Mother, there are times when I can’t resist the urge to kill, accumulating profound sins.”
target: "Ex quo ad Terram Matrem conversus sum, interdum impetum interficendi repellere non valeo, peccata profunde accumulans."

source: Recalling his earlier deduction, Lumian inquired casually, “Then why not fully confine yourself?”
target: Meminens deductionis suae priores, Lumian leviter inquisivit: "Cur igitur te omnino non constringis?"

source: “Confinement won’t suffice. I can’t do it, and it can’t be achieved that way.”
target: "Constrictio non sufficit. Id facere non possum, nec eo modo effici potest."

source: The Demon with ice‑blue eyes displayed pain once again.
target: Daemon oculis glacie caeruleis iterum dolorem ostendit.

source: Indeed, closely tied to the blood‑colored Demon in the valley… Yet, as a Coldblooded, why does the act of killing, and the subsequent “healing” by the Church of Earth Mother’s reverence for life, still cause you pain?
target: Re vera, arcte conexus Daemone sanguine colorato in valle… Attamen, ut frigidus, cur actus interficendi et postea "sanatio" per venerationem Vitae a Ecclesia Terrae Matris tibi adhuc dolorem efficit?

source: Lumian decided to steer the conversation to a less sensitive realm and soothe the other party.
target: Lumian decrevit sermonem ad rem minus sensibilem convertere et alteri consolari.

source: In a relaxed tone, he said, “I apologize. I wasn’t courteous earlier and failed to inquire about your preferred address.”
target: "Ignosce mihi. Prius non fui urbanus nec interrogavi te de forma ad te loquendum quam praeferres."

source: The Demon with ice‑blue eyes stared blankly for a moment before responding, “Naboredisley.”
target: Daemon oculis glacie caeruleis per momentum vacuo intuebatur, antequam responderet: "Naboredisley."
